breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π * d^4 / 32 for the polar moment of inertia in both the shear stress formula (τ_max = T * c / J) and the angle of twist formula (φ = T * L / (J * G)). There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 anywhere in the specification, matching the ground truth prompt which properly applies torsion formulas with J.
